frameworkNotes.cis: CIS control IDs carried over from the VSAT 1.x mapping (CIS VMware ESXi 7.0 Benchmark, edition not recorded). They are marked unverified until mapped against the licensed CIS ESXi 8.0 v1.4.0 / ESXi 7.0 v1.6.0 documents. CIS publishes no vCenter or NSX benchmark.
frameworkNotes.scg: Broadcom/VMware vSphere Security Configuration Guide setting or topic name. Guide edition to be confirmed during mapping review.
frameworkNotes.vsat: VSAT-native check derived from vendor documentation or security engineering practice; no external control ID.

workPackages.title: Apply vendor security patches
workPackages.outcome: Hosts, vCenter and NSX run builds at or above the fixed versions of applicable advisories.
prerequisites: Review advisory applicability and OEM custom images
Validate backups of vCenter and NSX
workPackages.impact: Host reboots with vMotion evacuation; vCenter/NSX management downtime during upgrade.
workPackages.rollback: Revert via vSphere Lifecycle Manager image rollback, vCenter file-based backup restore, or NSX backup restore.
workPackages.validation: Re-run VSAT; advisory findings move to PASS and builds match the target.

workPackages.title: Plan upgrade from unsupported releases
workPackages.outcome: All components run releases within vendor general support.
workPackages.rollback: Staged upgrade with tested rollback plan.

workPackages.title: Harden ESXi management services
workPackages.outcome: SSH, ESXi Shell, SLP and other unneeded services are stopped and set to start manually.
prerequisites: Confirm no tooling depends on SSH
workPackages.impact: Operators lose persistent shell access; use break-glass enablement.
workPackages.rollback: Start the service and restore the startup policy.

workPackages.title: Enforce ESXi access and account policy
workPackages.outcome: Lockdown mode, account lockout, password quality, timeouts and AD admin group are configured.
prerequisites: Confirm vCenter management works in lockdown mode
workPackages.rollback: Revert advanced settings / disable lockdown from vCenter.

workPackages.title: Centralize ESXi logging, time and core dumps
workPackages.outcome: Hosts send logs to authorized collectors, persist logs, sync time and send core dumps centrally.
prerequisites: Syslog collector and NTP sources available
workPackages.validation: Logs received centrally; VSAT findings PASS.

workPackages.title: Apply ESXi host hardening settings
workPackages.outcome: Host advanced settings, firewall and certificates meet the selected profile.
workPackages.rollback: Restore previous values from the VSAT evidence package.

workPackages.title: Harden virtual machine configuration
workPackages.outcome: VM advanced settings and devices follow the selected profile.
prerequisites: Change window for power-cycle where required
workPackages.impact: Most VMX settings apply at next power-on; device removal may need a power cycle.
workPackages.rollback: Restore the previous ExtraConfig values / re-add devices.

workPackages.title: Remove stale snapshots and update VMware Tools
prerequisites: Confirm snapshots are not the only recovery point

workPackages.title: Enforce virtual switch Layer-2 security
workPackages.outcome: Promiscuous mode, MAC changes and forged transmits rejected; overrides and VLAN usage controlled.
prerequisites: Identify workloads that need exceptions (e.g. nested ESXi, appliances)
Record approved exceptions in the scope file
workPackages.impact: Workloads relying on MAC spoofing lose connectivity.
workPackages.validation: Re-run VSAT; network findings PASS or have active exceptions.

workPackages.title: Improve availability configuration
workPackages.outcome: HA/admission control enabled, redundant uplinks and multi-host clusters.

workPackages.title: Tighten vCenter privileges and settings
workPackages.outcome: Admin rights granted via groups; retention and password settings meet policy.
workPackages.rollback: Re-add removed permissions from the evidence package.

workPackages.title: Secure storage access and encryption
workPackages.outcome: iSCSI mutual CHAP, Kerberos NFS where possible, vSAN encryption per policy.

workPackages.title: Harden NSX management plane
workPackages.outcome: NSX backups, syslog, NTP, authentication policy, certificates and cluster health are in order.
prerequisites: Backup target and syslog collector available

workPackages.title: Tighten NSX distributed firewall policy
workPackages.outcome: Default deny with logging, no any-any allows, scoped Applied-To, no stale or shadowed rules, no unjustified exclusions, all workloads covered by policy.
prerequisites: Flow analysis (e.g. NSX Intelligence / flow logs) to build allow rules
workPackages.impact: High: incorrect rules can block production traffic.
workPackages.rollback: Revert via NSX policy draft/rollback or saved configuration.
workPackages.validation: Re-run VSAT; review attack-path explorer for interrupted paths.

workPackages.title: Tighten NSX gateway firewall and NAT
workPackages.outcome: Gateway default deny and NAT rules subject to firewall.

workPackages.title: Complete manual review items
workPackages.outcome: Controls that cannot be automated are reviewed and evidenced.
workPackages.validation: Record evidence and exceptions in the scope file.
